per_article_summaries: Williams team principal James Vowles reveals Alex Albon's late pitstops were a deliberate decision. The final laps of the race at Suzuka were turned into a live testing session. The Grove outfit has had a troublesome start to the 2026 season after it missed private testing in Barcelona.

Aston Martin chief trackside officer Mike Krack says there are no issues between the team and engine supplier Honda. The British team switched from a customer Mercedes engine supply to a works partnership with Honda for 2026. The decision has spectacularly backfired in F1’s new technical era, with the Honda engine generating vibrations.

Formula 1 fans react to Esteban Ocon's 'Keeping Up With The Hamiltons' joke. Ocon suggested the show when asked by F1.com which driver was most likely to go on a reality TV show. McLaren driver Lando Norris simply said, "Lewis Hamilton"

Pierre Gasly has landed a new role with French fashion brand Lacoste. The Alpine Formula 1 driver will be the face of the famous Lacoste polo shirt. Lacoste's chief executive officer said Gasly "perfectly embodies the spirit of performance and tenacity"

Sergio Perez has denied claims from Mario Andretti that he’s a “bit rusty” upon his Formula 1 return, saying he’s “performing on a very high level” Perez was dropped by Red Bull at the end of 2024 and took a sabbatical before signing with F1 debutant Cadillac for 2026.

Kimi Antonelli has won two of the first three grands prix in the 2026 season. The Italian is three years younger than Lewis Hamilton was when he won his first grand prix in 2007. Sebastian Vettel set the fastest lap in just his third grand prix, outpacing Oscar Piastri and Max Verstappen by 0.074s.

Fernando Alonso and partner Melissa Jimenez have welcomed their first child. The two-time champion shared a picture of the present on Instagram. The present was paddock credentials with the message, "Welcome to the F1 family" The Spaniard is preparing for the Japanese Grand Prix at Suzuka.
